gone.ask_friend: Have you seen Zakk lately? Could you talk to him for me?
gone.goodbye_note: Waves are good out here. Didn't wanna make things weird back there. No worries, dude. Seriously. —Z

letter.reply: Got your letter, dude. Read it on the beach. ...Coming back up. Save me a window seat.

choices.text: Zakk, I'm sorry. No excuses.
Zakk, I treated you badly.
Hey, dude. Long time.
You have a place here. You always will.
Your window seat's still open.
The floors are way too clean without you.

lines.text: Whoa, nice spot, dude. Smells like a perfect swell in here. I'm Zakk.
Hey, new place! Mind if I post up and catch some flavor? I'm Zakk.
Good vibes in here. I can already tell. I'm Zakk.
Dude, two whole weeks? I almost sent out a search party. Okay, not really. But I thought about it.
Long time, man. The waves have been mellow, but the stew hasn't been the same.
Yo, been a minute! The tide's been low without you.
Look who washed back in! I was starting to wonder, dude.
Hey, you're back. Good to see you again, seriously.
No worries about last time, man. Burnt's just extra crispy, right?
It's all good. Everybody wipes out sometimes.
Hey, I'm not even mad. Can't be, it's not in me.
That was gnarly good last time. I've been thinking about it all week.
Straight-up barrel-ride flavor. You've got a gift, dude.
Wait, fish stew? You're the best, man.
Okay, now I'm definitely staying a while.
Another good day. Another good wave.
Cool place, cool people. Can't ask for more.
Just gonna sit back and soak it in.
[name]! Thought you paddled off somewhere, dude.
Last one was a little crispy, man. Still ate it. No worries.
Dude. Last time? Gnarly. I told, like, three people.
You know, this place feels like home break now.
I tell everyone about this spot. Everyone.
[name]! My dude. What's cookin'? Literally.
Funny thing. I was only gonna stay here a week. That was, like, a month ago.
There you are, man. I actually missed this place. Weird feeling. Good weird.
Bit burnt last time, dude. Telling you 'cause you're crew now. Crew's honest.
Last meal was so good I skipped a surf session for it. That's huge for me.
[name]! Crew's here. And by crew I mean me.
I cancelled a trip down the coast this week. Didn't feel like going. That's weird, right? That's weird for me.
Dude, where'd you go? I'm supposed to be the one who drifts off!
Burnt last time, dude. Don't care. I'd eat your burnt stuff forever.
Last time was the best meal I've had on any coast. Not even kidding.
[name]! My guy! Best spot on the whole coast, right here.
I signed a lease, dude. Like, a whole year. Me. Wild.
Hey, so... '[last_rude_line].' Been thinking about it. No worries, though. Seriously.
Can't stay long. Waves are calling. (They aren't. He checks his phone and puts it away.)
What's good, dude? Actually, don't tell me. Everything's good. I'm easy.

choices.text: I'll make you something really good, then.
choices.reply: See? Good vibes. I knew it.

choices.text: Easy, huh? I'll bring you a bowl of sand.
choices.reply: Ha! I've had worse, man. The [dish], please.

choices.text: The [dish] is great today.
choices.reply: Sold. No questions.

choices.text: Can you just pick something, please?
choices.reply: Oh, totally, no worries. The [dish]. (Nothing in his voice changes.)

lines.text: Swell's tiny today. Perfect day to eat instead of surf.

choices.text: Lucky for me, then.
choices.reply: Lucky for both of us, dude.

choices.text: Can penguins even surf?
choices.reply: That's what everyone back home said, man. Watch me.

choices.text: What'll it be?
choices.reply: The [dish]. Hit me.

choices.text: Nobody cares about the waves.
choices.reply: Ha, fair. No worries.

lines.text: Oh, man, sorry about the sand. It just kinda follows me.

choices.text: Don't worry about it. Sand means you've been somewhere fun.
choices.reply: Ha. That's a nice way to see it, dude.

choices.text: I'm charging you a sweeping fee.
choices.reply: Fair. Payment in seashells?

choices.text: No problem. What can I get you?
choices.reply: The [dish], man.

choices.text: Can you wipe your feet next time?
choices.reply: Oh, totally. My bad, dude. No worries. (He picks a table farther in.)

lines.text: I've been in town for a month now, dude. That's, like, a record for me.

choices.text: I hope you stay a lot longer.
choices.reply: ...Huh. Nobody's ever said that to me, man.

choices.text: It's the food. You're trapped now.
choices.reply: Delicious trap, dude. Best kind.

choices.text: Where were you before this?
choices.reply: Everywhere, man. Nowhere long. The [dish], please.

choices.text: Hope you leave soon.
choices.reply: Ha. Yeah, probably. No worries. (He looks out the window for a while.)

lines.text: I don't really stay places, you know? Stay too long, stuff gets heavy.

choices.text: Some heavy things are worth carrying.
choices.reply: (A long pause.) ...Gonna think about that one, dude.

choices.text: Too late. You're a regular. It's in the paperwork.
choices.reply: Ha! Can't argue with paperwork.

choices.text: You've stayed here pretty long.
choices.reply: Yeah. I noticed that too.

choices.text: Sounds like an excuse.
choices.reply: Maybe it is, man. No worries. (He orders and doesn't say much else.)

lines.text: I'm thinking about teaching surf lessons here. Like, staying-here staying. What do you think?

choices.text: I think this town's lucky to have you.
choices.reply: ...You can't just say stuff like that, dude. I'll cry into my stew.

choices.text: Only if my lessons are free.
choices.reply: Free forever, man. Payment in stew.

choices.text: Do it. You'd be great.
choices.reply: Yeah? Yeah. Okay. I'm doing it.

choices.text: Nobody would sign up.
choices.reply: ...Yeah. Probably not. No worries.

lines.text: Hey. All good. Just the [dish], dude.
What do you recommend, [name]? I trust you, man.

favorite.text: Fish stew?! You get me, dude.

disliked.text: Love it. You can't miss with me.

other.text: Love it. You can't miss with me.

lines.text: Surprise me, dude. Whatever you make, I'm stoked.

favorite.text: Fish stew. The best. You're the best.

lines.text: Hey, I never got your name, dude.

choices.text: (Tell him your name.)
choices.reply: ...[name]. Rad. That's a good wave name.

lines.text: Gnarly. Straight-up gnarly.
Solid, man. Solid.
Extra crispy. Love that for me.
Thanks, [name]. You always make it look so easy.
Whoa, that looks gnarly, dude. Thanks.
Little crispy, man. No worries.
You cook like the rest of the crew back there, dude. That's a big compliment.
Bit overdone, man. Still eating every bite.
Dude. Anyone cooking in this kitchen is family to me.
Wiped out a little, huh? Happens to the best of us, man.
Thanks, man.
Thanks.
Ever surfed? You should. I'll teach you. Free lessons. Payment in stew.
I've been to, like, twenty beaches. This town's got a good one. Not the best one. But good.
(He shows you his phone.) Surf report says tomorrow's gonna be epic. Says that every day. Never right. Love it.
You ever feel like you're supposed to be somewhere else? Like there's a better wave down the coast?

choices.text: Not really. I'm happy right here.
choices.reply: ...That sounds nice, man. Must be nice.

choices.text: Only when I burn things.
choices.reply: Ha! Then you'd never leave, dude.

choices.text: Sometimes. But I chose to stay.
choices.reply: Chose to stay. Huh. Never tried that.

choices.text: Then go find it.
choices.reply: Yeah. Maybe I should.

lines.text: I knew this one kid, best surfer I ever saw. Came from some cold little town up north, can't remember the name. Rad dude though.
I knew this one kid, best surfer I ever saw. Came from some cold little town up north, can't remember the name. Rad dude though.
Grew up in this tiny cold town. Everybody fished. Nobody surfed. Penguins swim, man, we don't surf. That's what they all said.

choices.text: And you proved them all wrong.
choices.reply: ...Never thought of it like that. Thanks, dude.

choices.text: Their loss. Bet you surf better than all of them fish.
choices.reply: Ha! That's not hard, man.

choices.text: Maybe they had a point.
choices.reply: Ha. Yeah. Maybe.

lines.text: First board I ever had was a piece of driftwood. Still got it, actually. Carried it to every beach.
People think I never get mad 'cause nothing bugs me. Nah. I just figured out holding on to stuff makes you sink.
Grew up in this tiny cold town. Everybody fished. Nobody surfed. Penguins swim, man, we don't surf. That's what they all said.

choices.text: And you proved them all wrong.
choices.reply: ...Never thought of it like that. Thanks, dude.

choices.text: Their loss. Bet you surf better than all of them fish.
choices.reply: Ha! That's not hard, man.

choices.text: Maybe they had a point.
choices.reply: Ha. Yeah. Maybe.

lines.text: First board I ever had was a piece of driftwood. Still got it, actually. Carried it to every beach.
People think I never get mad 'cause nothing bugs me. Nah. I just figured out holding on to stuff makes you sink.
Funny thing about staying, dude. It doesn't feel heavy at all. Feels like floating.
You're the reason I unpacked. Like, actually unpacked. My stuff's in drawers now, man.
Just vibing today, man.
Cheddar tried surfing with me today, dude. He was terrible. Like, historically terrible. Rad guy.
I called Mabel 'dude' today. She said I can't call her that. She was kinda smiling though, man.
Window seat? Perfect, dude. I like facing the water. Even when there's no water.
Ahh. Good spot. Good vibes.
No window? No worries, man. I'll just imagine one.
My spot. You remembered, dude.
Same seat as always. I'm basically part of the furniture now, man.
All good. Every seat's a good seat here.
Back home, I never had a spot anywhere. Kinda nice having one here, dude.
Window seat. Best view in town. Well, second best. The beach is first.
Home seat. ...Ha. Never thought I'd call anything that, dude.

before.narration: He taps the board on the wall on his way past.

lines.text: Still looks good up there, man.
Here's good, man.
This one's fine.
Nice, dude. Thanks.
Ooh, cold. Perfect.
[fav_drink]! You get me, man.
Not what I ordered, but hey, no worries. I'll drink anything.
Thanks, [name]. Smooth service, dude.
Thanks, dude. Smooth service.
You remembered my [fav_drink]? Gnarly.
Ha, a mix-up? All good, man. It's like a surprise wave.
Cheers, [name].

after.narration: He raises his glass to nobody in particular.

lines.text: Cheers, man.

after.narration: He raises his glass to nobody in particular.

lines.text: [fav_drink]. Tastes like the summer I first learned to surf.
Wrong one, dude. ...Still drinking it. That's how I roll.
To the best spot in town.
You don't even have to ask anymore. That's crew, dude.
Even your mistakes taste good, man.
Thanks.
Thanks, man.
No worries.

after.narration: He drinks it without looking at it.

lines.text: Thanks.
Thanks.
It's fine.
Got any lemonade, dude? Tastes like the beach. In a good way.
Whatever's good, man. A [drink]? Sure, sounds rad.
Lemonade, please, dude. Can't surf thirsty.
Trying a [drink] today, dude. New wave, you know?
The usual lemonade, dude. Extra ice if you've got it.
Feeling a [drink] today, man.
Lemonade, dude. You already know.
Surprise me, dude. Ride whatever wave you want.
Just a lemonade, dude. All good.
Lemonade's fine.
Catch you on the next wave, dude.
Catch you on the next wave, dude. (He leaves a seashell next to his tip.)
Later, [name]. Same wave, same time.
See you tomorrow, [name]. ...Huh. 'Tomorrow.' I never used to know where I'd be tomorrow.
Later, dude. I'll be here tomorrow. And the day after. Get used to it.
(He taps the driftwood board for luck on his way in.)
Hey, it's Zakk.
...I might, dude. Might.
Just the stew, delivered. I'm gonna catch a wave after. No worries.
Just the [dish], delivered. No worries.
That's it, dude. Later.

choices.text: Come by sometime. We miss you here.
(Just send the food.)

lines.text: (Sand on his feet. Sunglasses down, which he never does.) Hey, dude. ...So. I came back. I never come back to places.

choices.text: I'm sorry. I treated you badly, and you didn't deserve it.
choices.reply: (He pushes his sunglasses up.) Thanks, man. That means a lot. Like, actually.

choices.text: You can tell me when I hurt you, you know.
choices.reply: ...Yeah. I'm not great at that. Gonna try.

choices.text: Your window seat's still open.
choices.reply: ...Yeah? Cool. Cool. (He sits down.)
